# dsh-codex-style · Codex style
English | 中文
An independent, optional DeepSeek Harness output-style plugin targeting desktop **0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2
.1-rc.2**. It does not modify DSH, Butler, or Aqua source code, and starts no service or resident pr
2**. It does not modify DSH, Butler, or Aqua source code, and starts no service or resident process.
`engines.dsh` and the optional peer `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` both declare exactly `0.2.0-rc.2 ||
0.2.1-rc.2`. The optional peer describes the host without installing another DSH runtime; it does no
t claim support for later prereleases. Recheck Client Slots and the `systemPrompt` service after upg
rading DSH; local tests do not replace live App acceptance.
## Features and boundaries
- **Answer wording:** conclusions first, concise delivery, real verification, and explicit disclosur
e of checks not run. The prompt is a presentation preference, not a change to tools, permissions, or

execution rules; identical behavior across all models is not guaranteed.
- **Progress display:** re
uses native work-step grouping and collapsing, with elapsed time derived from original `turn/start`
/ `turn/end` timestamps. Failed and stopped turns cannot be collapsed as a whole. DSH still renders

final answers, approvals, errors, and attachments.
- **File changes:** fully preserves DSH's native
change cards, expanded lists, and Diff interactions. It registers no turn-tail card, hides no native

cards, fetches or caches no separate change data, and adds no undo feature.
- **Theme compatibility
:** adjusts only chat answer text and its own progress headings; it does not override Aqua layout, g
lass effects, or theme tokens.
## Install and build
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The package and repository are named `dsh-codex-style`, with repository metadata `https://github.com
/fegnze/dsh-codex-style` and local directory `<workspace>/MySpace/dsh-plugins/dsh-codex-style`. Cord
is component IDs `codex-style` / `codex-style-prompt`, settings component IDs, existing browser pref
erence keys, and the prompt section ID remain unchanged. The client loader and style ownership use t
he new package name.
The npm allowlist includes the patch, Host/prompt entry points, built client, and English/Chinese RE
ADMEs; it excludes tests, dependency directories, browser snapshots, and logs. Source retains the My
Space root repository's Zlib license; see `LICENSE` for a copy. Dependencies retain their respective
repository's Zlib license; see `LICENSE` for a copy. Dependencies retain their respective licenses.
Add this directory's absolute path in the **desktop profile** plugin manager, or install the local d
irectory through the Agent's `plugin_manager`. Build artifacts live in the ignored `lib/` directory,
so build before installing. The current setup uses a local link installation; do not move the sourc
e directory arbitrarily.
Refresh the current DSH window after installation or updates. This standalone plugin has no developm
ent watcher: rebuild and refresh after changing client source; refresh-free updates are not promised
. There is no need to start another Web server.
Under **Settings → General settings**, the recommended setting for “Work-step display” and “Performa
nce and usage” is “Compact”. The plugin does not override these host preferences; you can switch bac
k to detailed display at any time. Persisted desktop preferences may take precedence over profile de
tailed display at any time. Persisted desktop preferences may take precedence over profile defaults.
## Disabling and scope
- **Disable only the UI:** Settings → General settings → **Codex 风格** (Codex style). This immediatel
y removes the plugin's CSS and progress headings and restores native rendering; native file-change c
ards are always preserved. The switch is stored per browser origin and does not change the model pro

mpt or native work-step preferences.
- **Disable only wording preferences:** disable `codex-style-pr

ompt` (module `dsh-codex-style/prompt`) in plugin management.
- **Disable everything:** disable the
entire `dsh-codex-style` bundle in plugin management.
By default the prompt is added globally to the current profile, and the UI applies to that profile's
sessions. No Agent presets are created or changed, and the default model is unchanged. To apply wor
ding preferences to only one preset, disable the global `codex-style-prompt` and declare `dsh-codex-
style/prompt` in that preset's `plugins`. The UI switch is not a preset switch.
## Style lifecycle and verification
DSH's Client module loader attributes unmarked `style` tags to the module materialized next and remo
ves them when that module unloads. This is not a shared general-purpose style layer: this plugin wri
tes `data-plugin` and `data-plugin-css` **before** inserting its styles into the DOM, and removes on
ly its own style tags. Progress arrows declare both SVG dimensions and inline dimensions to prevent
unbounded enlargement when CSS is missing.
Each `npm test` first rebuilds the real client bundle, then verifies: no registration or hiding of n
ative change cards; style ownership before insertion; no accidental deletion when simulating another
module claiming/unloading styles; repeated toggling and unload lifecycle; error/stop boundaries; re
al timing; and bounded SVGs.
A previous session in the existing host at `http://127.0.0.1:19387` verified zero custom-drawn cards
, visible native cards retaining all 24 records when expanded, and native file buttons opening the s
idebar Diff. After simulating the loader claiming/unloading other styles, this plugin still owned it
s styles, with zero console or Slot errors. This is a historical acceptance record, not a claim that
the current installation has been revalidated.
Real-browser acceptance and Happy DOM component tests are reported separately. The first browser che
ck of the historical custom-card implementation did not cover later loading/unloading of other plugi
ns and could not establish long-term style reliability; that implementation has been removed. DSH ow
ns native change-card data scope, lifetime, and Diff behavior; this plugin does not reinterpret or r
ange-card data scope, lifetime, and Diff behavior; this plugin does not reinterpret or rebuild them.
## Layout

- `src/prompt.mjs`: independently removable wording preferences.
- `src/host.mjs`: empty Host entry

for client discovery.
- `src/client.jsx`: progress headings, settings switch, and style lifecycle.
-

`src/model.mjs`: actual elapsed time and progress state.
- `src/style.css`: scoped CSS for answer t
ext and progress headings.
